current_best_understanding.status: Historical characterization is promising; independent magnitude remains uncertain; forward validation is underway.
current_best_understanding.historical_holdout_evidence: V2 was positive but below the confirmation threshold: UNRESOLVED / UNDERPOWERED, not fully holdout-confirmed.
current_best_understanding.type_2_research: CLOSED. Regime label, volatility level, drawdown velocity, and rolling IBS spread did not jointly provide adequate timing and discrimination.
current_best_understanding.next_direction: Orthogonal event-driven / Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD) engine.
current_best_understanding.portfolio_target: Approximately 20% long-run net CAGR with material absolute and risk-adjusted outperformance versus SPY total return.

portfolio_objective.primary: Build a systematic portfolio capable of approximately 20% long-run net CAGR while materially outperforming SPY buy-and-hold on both absolute and risk-adjusted returns.

interpretation_bands.interpretation: Generally unattractive versus long-run passive equity returns unless risk is dramatically lower.
Potentially useful, but a finished portfolio may not justify complexity unless risk-adjusted performance is excellent.

portfolio_objective.scope_note: These are portfolio-level goals, not pass/fail thresholds for individual signals. A signal with several percentage points of genuine annual factor alpha, strong evidence, reasonable costs, capacity, and low correlation may still be valuable.

terminology.SPY CAGR: Compounded SPY total return over the identical test period.
terminology.CAGR spread: Strategy CAGR minus SPY CAGR, expressed in percentage points; never called alpha.
terminology.Factor alpha: Intercept from the stated factor regression.
terminology.Excess return: A benchmark-relative return whose benchmark, date range, and calculation must be stated explicitly.

holdout_policy.statement: Preregistering a hypothesis now does not create another clean historical holdout. Already-viewed history can characterize a frozen rule but cannot independently confirm it.
valid_new_evidence: prospective future observations under a frozen rule
a genuinely untouched independent dataset or universe, if one exists

core_conclusion: IBS / short-term mean reversion is the dominant mechanism.
RSI2 provides related but partially redundant information.
Turnaround Tuesday provides a smaller calendar contribution.
Sector Rotation did not justify its portfolio weight at the tested weekly rebalance frequency.
Quality / exclusion filters can be useful; Quality Q5 is the material guardrail and NSI Q5 is largely redundant insurance.
No reliable aggregate TYPE 2 regime-transition protection rule was found.
Further tuning of closely related mean-reversion signals risks overfitting; the core is a frozen engine undergoing forward validation.

paper_trading.checkpoint_interpretation: Predefined review milestone, not automatic approval.

type_2_transition_research.historical_apparent_success_note: The apparent benefit was a methodology artifact and did not survive controlled testing.
type_2_transition_research.conclusion: No tested TYPE 2 trigger simultaneously achieved adequate timing and discrimination. Do not continue parameter-searching these trigger families without genuinely new information or a materially different mechanism.

conditional_search_policy.note: Findings came from a broad conditional search involving multiple signals, regimes, volatility states, drawdown states, weekdays, transitions, and related cuts. Nominal t-statistics do not have the interpretation of a single preregistered hypothesis test.
affected_findings: other regime, volatility, drawdown, weekday, or transition-conditioned discoveries
